_schema: Every numeric spec is a manufacturer-published value. Each part carries a `_source` block (url, tier, retrieved date). No field may be surfaced to a user without its source — that is the whole point of this file (R28/R35/R68). Values are stored AS PUBLISHED; unit conversions (kg.cm -> N.m etc.) are done deterministically by scripts/motor_math.py, never pre-baked here, so the catalog stays a pure record of sourced facts.

_tier_legend.2: community/third-party — must be labeled tier-2 downstream

5203-2402-0019.name: goBILDA 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor, 19.2:1
5203-2402-0019.encoder_cpr_output_note: Published at the OUTPUT shaft; reflects the exact (non-rounded) gear ratio. Do NOT recompute from the rounded 19.2 label — 537.7/28 = 19.20 exact. goBILDA labels this 'PPR' but it is counts/rev.

_source.note: manufacturer product page; max output power not listed

5203-2402-0014.name: goBILDA 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor, 13.7:1
5203-2402-0014.encoder_cpr_output_note: 384.5/28 = 13.73 exact ratio; the 13.7 label is rounded. Use this published value for tick math, not 28*13.7.

_source.note: manufacturer product page; max output power not listed

REV-41-1291.name: REV Robotics HD Hex Motor (bare, no gearbox)
REV-41-1291.encoder_cpr_motor_note: 28 counts/rev at the MOTOR shaft (bare). With a gearbox, output CPR = 28 * gearbox_ratio — computed by motor_math.py from the chosen ratio, since this bare motor ships without one.

REV-41-1300.name: REV Robotics Core Hex Motor
REV-41-1300.encoder_cpr_output_note: 288 counts/rev at the OUTPUT shaft (integrated gearbox).

_source.note: manufacturer product page; free current not listed
